Why Choose JEC?

Discover what sets JEC apart as a leading institution for engineering education, blending academic excellence with modern facilities.

AICTE Approved

Affiliated with RTU, Kota, ensuring quality education.

Modern Infrastructure

State-of-the-art laboratories and campus facilities.

Experienced Faculty

Highly qualified and experienced teaching staff.

Strong Placements

Robust placement cell with top-tier company tie-ups.

Research Opportunities

Access to cutting-edge research projects and labs.

Vibrant Community

Engaging student clubs and extracurricular activities.

Stories Of Excellence

At JEC, we empower students to achieve their career goals through dedicated support, top-tier opportunities, and strong industry connections.

Placement Cell

Our dedicated Placement Cell offers personalized support, securing internships and job opportunities with leading companies for every student.

Top Recruiters

Our 2021–25 placement sessions attracted top recruiters from IT, core engineering, and management, offering diverse career paths.

Career Outcomes

We collaborate with leading organizations to ensure exceptional career outcomes, preparing students for success in a competitive world.
